what_this_is: Release contracts that must never gate a build again, by content hash. release_contracts.load_contract consults this, so a superseded document cannot be resurrected by copying it into the live directory. The originals are NOT edited: a historical artifact that quietly grows a new number is worse than a stale one.

contracts.why: prepared against a 70-record pet-friendly authority. PTF-MILWAUKEE-FOUNDER-DECISION-040 admitted three more and one more refusal, so its expected_record_count, its expected_sha256 and its held-identity list all describe a market that no longer exists.

prepared against the 153-identity census and an eight-record policy package (PTF-INDIANAPOLIS-DECISION-APPLICATION-001). PTF-INDIANAPOLIS-HARDENED-RECENSUS-002 re-censused the market to 265, PTF-INDIANAPOLIS-FOUNDER-REVIEW-002 closed a 50-row founder review, PTF-INDIANAPOLIS-PROMOTION-AUTHORITY-PREP-003 built the 257-row promotion census and a 48-record authority, and PTF-INDIANAPOLIS-FOUNDER-PROMOTION-004 promoted them; the old expected_count, expected_sha256, record count and route counts describe a market that no longer exists.
